title: Materialized Result Lifecycle
summary: Query and evaluation results are materialised once and stored, preventing repeated execution of the same capability.
why: Optimizes performance and ensures consistency for paginated results; paging only reads the stored row array.
invariants: A result is bound to the AbilitySession that created it.
Paging (cursor) is over the stored row array only; it never invokes the capability again.
Results are released when their TTL expires or they are explicitly deleted.
